title: Kernel component of affine formal quotient projection
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, I an ideal of A, J the ideal sheaf on Spec A associated with I through GammaSpecIso, M any A-module, and m>0. Define p as the tilde/global-sections unit M to Gamma(Spec A, tilde M), followed by global sections of the explicit cokernel projection formalModuleQuotientπ J m (tilde M) of def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module. Then the kernel of p is I^m times M, namely I^m • (top : Submodule A M).

source.place: Tags 01I8 and 01IC; Tag 087W in coherent.tex, affine module correspondence

proof.text: Identify the positive power inclusion range with J(U)^m by the ideal-times theorem, and compute the range of multiplication on tilde M by tensor induction. The affine cokernel-image theorem identifies the projection kernel with this range. Transport along the tilde unit and GammaSpecIso to identify the inverse image with I^m M. The module docstring gives the complete generator-by-generator argument.

theorem formalModuleQuotient_affine_projection_kernel
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (J : (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)).IdealSheafData)
    (hJ : J = Scheme.IdealSheafData.ofIdealTop
      (I.map (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv.hom))
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} A) (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    let p := (tilde.toTildeΓNatIso (R := CommRingCat.of A)).hom.app M ≫
      (moduleSpecΓFunctor (R := CommRingCat.of A)).map
        (formalModuleQuotientπ J m ((tilde.functor (CommRingCat.of A)).obj M))
    LinearMap.ker p.hom = I ^ m • (⊤ : Submodule A M)
